Left: peaceful wooden office desk, toy, quiet monitor and large physical lever switched down, powered-down server racks. Middle: the same orange four-legged toy with cream rectangular smiling mask and blue-gray tentacles on a swivel office chair, golden mechanical restraint ring, teal barrier keeping a distant purple cosmic eye beyond a doorway. Right: three generic virtual computer windows disintegrate into varied-size silver pixel paperclips around one bright square pixel-smile popup. Dark quiet backgrounds, obvious focal silhouettes, no gradients, realistic lighting, blur, watermark or operating-system branding.
